children: New Delhi, Sept. 21 -- Knowledge Marine share price witnessed strong volatility in morning trade on Monday, 21 September, even as the company announced the receipt of a work order from Mumbai Port Authority. Shares of Knowledge Marine and Engineering Works opened at Rs.2,990 against their previous close of Rs.2,887.20 and jumped 5.1% to an intraday high of Rs.3,034.85. However, the stock failed to hold altitude and dropped 1.6% to an intraday low of Rs.2,840.80 due to profit booking. Around 11 am, the stock was 0.67% down at Rs.2,867.85.
